text: Sell RGTI now — it's down 61% with revenue collapsing 34%, no path to profitability, and 21% short interest, meaning this business is fundamentally broken and the stock is likely headed lower.
Sell QBTS immediately — down 63% and nearly 67% off its high with no profits and extreme short interest of 21%, this is a speculation that has failed and capital should be preserved.
Sell BMNR as it's flashing red across every metric — down 24%, more than 50% off its high, terrible relative strength, and trading below key moving averages with no sign of recovery.

Trim MSTR to reduce your exposure — it's essentially a leveraged Bitcoin bet that's down 21% and nearly 47% off its high, and in a rising-rate environment this kind of speculative leverage works against you.

Add to GOOGL while it sits 27% off its highs — the fundamentals remain strong despite the price drop, and this kind of discount on a dominant business with healthy earnings doesn't come around often.
